title: Titanium Sludge Scraper Blade
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for this wastewater application prioritizing formability and corrosion resistance over strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, its natural TiO2 passivation provides immunity to pitting in chlorides up to 260C. This rationale is driven by clarifier sludge scraper blade and specific design requirements.
process: CNC machining from plate for wastewater geometry
TIG welding all-position with Class 6g gauge
Passivation DI rinse with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces — tailored for clarifier sludge scraper application
commonFailures: Crevice corrosion under gasket in wet service - mitigated by raised-face flange design per ASME B16.5 — critical for clarifier sludge scraper performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Sludge Scraper Blade suitable for Clarifier sludge scraper blade?
faq.a: Titanium Sludge Scraper Blade uses Grade 2 CP-Ti because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address wastewater operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Sludge Scraper Blade?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Sludge Scraper Blade is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for clarifier sludge scraper requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Sludge Scraper Blade require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. clarifier sludge scraper components require Pickling HF-HNO3 bath + passivation to restore passive film integrity on welded/seamed process surfaces — tailored for clarifier sludge scraper application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Sludge Scraper Blade shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Sludge Scraper Blade includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet clarifier sludge scraper specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Scraper blade / Sludge scraper wastewater components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
